title: ITC-Hulls automatic termination of hull cover cited as Clause 4.2 in fourteen candidate-facing sites; the mechanism taught is Clause 5.1
authorisation_source: MIW ORAL QB - RELEASE CONTENT BLOCKER CLOSURE instruction of 8 September 2026, section 0.A: close verified P1-A. The instruction records P1-A as already independently verified against the primary policy text and supplies the correct clause structure; this record re-verifies it against the instrument and against the repository's own evidence before acting.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Raised by the independent release qualification of this release candidate and confirmed here.
candidate_introduced: YES, AND BY THIS UNRELEASED RELEASE CANDIDATE. The string 'cl. 4.2' does not occur in ANY of the nine affected files on origin/main (9e26f02) - verified file by file with git show. The defect was introduced on 7 Sep 2026 by CORR-PASS2-PR1C-SUSPENSION-20260907 via tools/oral/apply_corr_pass2_r4.py and has never been in production. Shipping this candidate would have published a new examinable citation error into a bank that does not currently carry it. That is what makes it release-blocking rather than corpus debt.
authority: PRIMARY - Institute Time Clauses - Hulls, 1/11/95 (CL280). Clause 4 is CLASSIFICATION: 4.1 imposes the duty to keep the Vessel classed with a Society agreed by the Underwriters and to comply with the Society's recommendations, requirements and restrictions by their due dates; 4.2 is the consequence of breaching THAT DUTY - the Underwriters are discharged from liability under the insurance as from the date of the breach, with the discharge deferred until arrival at her next port if the Vessel is at sea. Clause 5 is TERMINATION: 5.1 terminates the insurance AUTOMATICALLY at the time of change of the Classification Society of the Vessel, or change, suspension, discontinuance, withdrawal or expiry of her Class, with the same at-sea deferral, and with the proviso that where the class event resulted from loss or damage covered by Clause 6 the automatic termination operates only if the Vessel sails from her next port without the prior approval of the Classification Society. CORROBORATION FROM THE REPOSITORY, and it is decisive: QB1_F#q7's own reg-box already reads 'Institute Time Clauses - Hulls 1/11/95, cl. 4 and 5.1 - Duty to maintain class; automatic termination of hull cover on suspension or withdrawal of class'. The card's prose contradicted its own reg-box. meoclass1/oral-intelligence/examiner-audit/PASS2_QUEUE_DISPOSITION.json round_4 field 'the_corpus_already_knew' independently records that same card as 'ITC-Hulls cl.4/5.1 correct throughout', three lines below the finding that writes cl. 4.2. The wrong number is a transcription slip, not a reading of the policy.
rationale: Every one of the fourteen candidate-facing occurrences teaches automatic termination - the words 'terminates hull cover automatically' or 'hull cover terminates automatically' - on suspension, discontinuance or withdrawal of class, with the at-sea deferral, and three of them also carry the Clause 6 disapplication. Automatic termination and the Clause 6 proviso are markers of Clause 5.1 and appear nowhere in Clause 4.2, whose consequence is discharge from liability for breach of a duty. The mechanism taught was therefore already correct and only the clause number was wrong, so only the clause number moves.
note: SCOPE. Fourteen candidate-facing sites in six cards and two cheat sheets, plus the governed changelog note and its derived index entry, plus two authoring surfaces that would have re-seeded the defect: known_traps.md entry 130, which is where the wrong number was first written down as the teaching to reuse, and the hardcoded adjudication in tools/oral/sweep_pr1c_family.py, which the Pass-2 release gate re-runs. NOT DONE, deliberately: the PASS2_QUEUE_DISPOSITION.json round-4 finding is left verbatim and annotated with a superseded_note, because it is the audit record of how the defect entered and rewriting it would destroy that evidence. tools/oral/apply_corr_pass2_r4.py is left unchanged as spent release evidence per tools/oral/SKILL.md section 2. No teaching, no reg-box entry, no PR1C proposition and no P&I proposition was touched.
